newsitem.title: UK: Chain of orders, fixtures cited in sugar freight.
newsitem.headline: Chain of orders, fixtures cited in sugar freight.

text.p: Fresh orders and fixtures were reported in the sugar freight market on Friday, according to information obtained by shipbrokers.
Pan Ocean fixed Ataman 38,000 dwt bulk delivery Hong Kong spot trip via Queensland redelivery Far East at $7,000 daily.

Genoc fixed 13,000 tonnes bagged sugar from Poland to the Mediterannean or the Red Sea prompt and South Africa Sugar Association fixed 18,500 tonnes bulk Durban/Japan for mid November, although the rates were not available.
Booker was said to have fixed 10,200 tonnes bulk sugar from Georgetown to Kantvik for mid November.
The day's new orders included E.D. & F Man with 31,500 tonnes bulk sugar from Recife and Maceio to Iran for November/December.

It also had 13,000 tonnes two percent bulk sugar from Dar es Salaam for mid-December to the UK. Bosco came in with 14,000 tonnes bagged from the Continent to Iran for prompt shipment and the World Food Programme was looking for 12,000 tonnes bagged sugar from Hamburg to Mersin or Iskenderun for prompt.
